Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST): Mutation in the platelet-derived growth factor alpha (PDGFRA) gene exon 12, codon 561, encoding a thymine to adenine substitution
Immunoreactivity: diffusely positive for myeloid stem cell antigen (CD34)
Histological finding: proliferating epithelioid cells and myxoid cells with an interlacing bundle pattern
Immunoreactivity: weakly or focally positive for c-kit proto-oncogene protein product (CD117)
Laparotomy finding: well-encapsulated tumor in the greater omentum
heterogeneous low density mass on CT
tumor receiving blood supply from epigastric artery
